title: Cranberry Jell-O Salad
nutrition_tip: This holiday cranberry Jell-O salad is made with cherry-flavored gelatin, cranbe…

ingredients.name: 2 (0.3 ounce) packages sugar-free cherry-flavored gelatin mix (such as Jell-O®)

steps.text: Combine boiling water and gelatin mix in a bowl; stir until gelatin is dissolved.
Stir in cranberry sauce and crushed pineapple.
Transfer to a large glass serving dish or 12 individual dishes. Sprinkle pecans on top.
Chill until set, 3 to 4 hours for individual dishes, or 4 hours to overnight for one large serving dish.
